  • Power backup for an uninterrupted lifestyle.
  • Housekeeping for a clean and hassle-free stay.
  • Dining services with nutritious meals.

items.question: What amenities are available at Colive PG in Navi Mumbai?
items.answer: Colive PGs in Navi Mumbai provide fully furnished rooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, laundry, housekeeping, power backup, nutritious meals, and secure access with 24/7 monitoring

items.question: Are there safe PG options for women in Navi Mumbai?
items.answer: Yes, Colive offers ladies PG in Navi Mumbai with female staff, CCTV surveillance, and secure entry, located near colleges like DY Patil University and ITM.

items.question: How much does a PG in Navi Mumbai cost monthly?
items.answer: Monthly rent starts from ₹7,100 for triple sharing, ₹8,800 for twin sharing, ₹15,500 for private rooms, and ₹17,200 for couple-friendly options.​

items.question: Which are the best locations for PGs in Navi Mumbai?
items.answer: Popular localities include Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Airoli, and Kharghar—close to colleges, tech hubs, and metro/railway stations.

items.question: How can I reach PGs in Navi Mumbai from Mumbai Airport or CST?
items.answer: From Mumbai Airport, Navi Mumbai PGs are accessible via cabs and buses (approx. 1.5 hours). From CST, local trains on the Harbour Line connect directly to Vashi and Nerul.
